landing.title: Build plans for wallet-ai
landing.lede: wallet-ai turns a two-word Telegram message into a real record in Wallet by BudgetBakers, because the app's data model is good and its entry UX is not. Built on Wallet's official REST API — probed live during design, which is how we learned it has no idempotency key: the identical request sent twice creates two transactions. Every expensive part of the plan exists to make that survivable. Each plan below is a sequence of disciplined TDD cycles. Pick a plan to read its cycles and parallel runbook.
